_comments.@duckdb/node-api: Pinned to 2.0.0-r.1 (DuckDB 2.0.0). History: originally pinned to 1.5.0 solely for DuckPGQ community-extension availability, then 1.5.4 once DuckLake's compaction/CHECKPOINT crash (duckdb/ducklake#525) was fixed by duckdb/ducklake#1095 and DuckPGQ shipped a 1.5.4 build. As of 2026-10-24 DuckPGQ has community builds for both DuckDB 1.5.6 and 2.0.0 (DuckDB v2 refs promoted in duckdb/community-extensions on 2026-10-20). DuckDB 2.0 requires parser extensions to be opted in per session, so loadDuckPgq() in src/db.js runs SET active_grammar_extensions = ['duckpgq'] on every pooled/user connection (it cannot be SET GLOBAL). CAVEAT (still open as of 2026-10-24): duckdb/ducklake#1108, a schema-cache key collision after the per-table schema_versions migration triggered by per-table schema evolution (this codebase does ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for blob metadata, see src/db.js). runMaintenance() in src/db.js (scheduled lake maintenance) works around #1108 by running maintenance as six explicit calls with a fresh, unpooled connection per table for merge_adjacent_files/rewrite_data_files instead of a single CHECKPOINT. Before bumping DuckDB again: re-check ducklake#1108, and confirm DuckPGQ has a matching build for the target DuckDB version (INSTALL duckpgq FROM community fails otherwise and graph endpoints report DuckPGQ as not loaded).
